text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I'll need to keep working on
my gate difficulties going forward."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In casual games, one or two mistakes
can be brushed off as blunders. But...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If the overall standard of the races goes up...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a session, Trainer.
About our next objective.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? As things are now,
do you think it'll be enough for the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I have to be honest with her. If she enters the Classic Triple Crown while still as inconsistent as she is now...
choice_data_list: This might be pretty tough... I mean, look who we're up against.
This might be pretty tough... I mean, look who we're up against, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Considering who the opponent is, huh...
Yeah, what about the other top contenders—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Both Pisa and Flash-san
have already secured GⅢ victories.
And in quite impressive fashion, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As for Rose—late last year, he brilliantly
claimed the Junior-class GⅠ Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The start, the mid-leg, and the final spurt.
No compromises can be made at any point...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Nailing the start dash is a given, but from there, I must run smoothly according to plan. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You need to acquire the "reproducibility"
to pull that off at any given moment.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"To test those out... it might be better
to run one more race before the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'd prefer to avoid excessive exhaustion if possible.
For instance――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How about the Mainichi Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Hai is a GIII held in late March.
choice_data_list: The Mainichi Hai sounds like a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a trial run before the main event, it seemed like an appropriate choice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You agree with me?
Then—it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If we can win through all that without making a single mistake, then maybe we can say we've earned the right to fight them.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's focus heavily on improving our start
before the Mainichi Hai. And then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll become someone who can run precisely
according to plan, at any given moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming her gate troubles and aiming for the ability to manage the race effectively.
Two months left until the final test: the Mainichi Hai.
